notes.title: Spooky Season Is Upon Us, Steam Scream Has Arrived!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Halloween is almost here and that means it's time to get scared. And if you're too scared to do something scary in real life, play some spooky video games instead!

During Steam Scream: The Revenge fest, many of the best horror games are discounted, and that goes for In Fear I trust as well! Until November 2 you can get it for -80% off. Spooked already?

To save even more money check out this bundle! The sale discount applies there as well + you get an additional bundle discount on games you don't own yet!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1442/In_Fear_I_Trust_Episodes_14_Collection_Pack/

And we have great news for fans of cosmic horror and H.P.Lovecraft in particular - Forgive Me Father 2, the Lovecraftian old-school FPS with comic-like visuals which just launched into Early Access, is a part of the sale too, go check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2272250/Forgive_Me_Father_2/

notes.title: In Fear I Trust is a part of Fulqrum Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We are so happy to announce that the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/FulqrumPublishing/sale/publishersale2022]Fulqrum Publisher Sale[/url] just started and In Fear I Trust is a part of it with an amazing discount!
[b]ALL of Fulqrum Publishing's games are discounted by up to 90% for an entire week![/b] The sale ends on October 27.

Besides, we have just launched a brand new game into Early Access, that being [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/]The Pegasus Expedition[/url]. If you have not checked it out yet, now is the perfect time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

Enjoy the sale, buy as many games as possible while they're discounted, play The Pegasus Expedition and don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]Social Media[/url] so you never miss any important info!

notes.title: Nightmarish rogue-like title Lovecraft's Untold Stories 2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

If you love darkness and horror elements, and we are certain you do, since you follow In Fear I Trust, you might be interested in a new game we've just published, being Lovecraft's Untold Stories 2!

It is a comic-style rogue-like nonstop action experience with a lot of Lovecraftian influence. Go ahead, watch the official trailer and learn more about the game!

[previewyoutube=_1UC_Uo2H-8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]LOVECRAFT'S UNTOLD STORIES 2:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401400/Lovecrafts_Untold_Stories_2/

notes.title: In Fear I Trust out now!
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

Four episodes of the creepy adventure game In Fear I Trust are out now. This psychological thriller has already received very positive reviews on mobile and it is now coming to PC.

Here are a few quotes:

“In Fear I Trust isn’t just a game title – it’s a directive” – Kotaku

"Dark, menacing and mysterious – not many titles can match the atmosphere this game creates." – Apps Magazine, 5/5

"What more can I say? “In Fear I Trust” has absolutely become a game I’d put my trust in." – Capsule Computers, 10/10

"An enthralling adventure that will keep your mind active, and skin crawling throughout. ...one to believe in!" – Apple 'N' Apps, 4/5

"As close to perfect as it gets." – Arcade Sushi, 85%

The first episode serves as a hub for the whole game. As soon as you purchase other episodes, you'll be able to access them from the first episode's menu.
